plugins.name: install-vault-memory
plugins.description: One-call installer for vault-memory in an Obsidian vault. Installs the CLI/MCP server AND the Obsidian plugin (with the plugin's serverCommand pre-seeded to the absolute CLI path, so it works on first open). Walks through 9 idempotent checkpoints (version, package manager, Node 22+, Ollama, embedding model, vault-memory binary, vault registration + initial index, Obsidian plugin, MCP smoketest). Defaults to autonomous mode. Supports a read-only health check via VAULT_MEMORY_DIAGNOSE=1. Use when the user says "/install-vault-memory", "install vault-memory", "set up memory", "Memory aktivieren", or when the mcp__vault-memory__* tools are missing.
